text: dsh-chat-settings 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的逐对话设置插件。它在会话标题和新会话区域提供设置入口，并在设置页管理启用该功能的工作区。用户可为单个对话附加系统提示词、限制保留的上下文轮数、覆盖 temperature 和最大输出 token，也可切换纯聊天模式以移除工具及运行时上下文。插件还支持创建独立的空白聊天工作区，适合需要按会话调整模型行为或控制上下文长度的用户。设置保存在本地 DSH 数据目录，无需额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-chat-settings adds per-conversation system prompts, context limits, sampling overrides, and pure chat without tools or runtime context to the DSH Web client. Users can enable workspaces on its settings page. Settings are stored locally; no API key or external service is needed.
想给不同的 DSH 对话分别设置系统提示词。
DSH 能不能只保留最近几轮对话，自动折叠更早的内容？
我想为某个会话单独调 temperature 和最大输出长度。
有没有办法在 DSH 里开一个不带工具和环境上下文的纯聊天？

dsh-chat-settings 的功能「逐对话提示词」：为单个对话保存专属系统提示词，并在请求组装时加入提示内容。
dsh-chat-settings 的功能「上下文轮数限制」：设置保留的最近对话轮数；超出后将较早内容替换成一条折叠提示。
dsh-chat-settings 的功能「采样参数覆盖」：在设置界面填写 temperature 和最大输出 token，发起请求时将有效值覆盖到请求参数。
dsh-chat-settings 的功能「纯聊天模式」：开启后请求仅保留本对话提示词，并移除工具、运行时上下文和部分预步骤消息。
dsh-chat-settings 的功能「工作区启用与空白聊天空间」：在设置页勾选工作区以显示入口，也可创建专用空白聊天工作区并启动会话。
dsh-chat-settings 会在本机 DSH 数据目录写入 chat-settings/settings.json，并可创建 chat-workspaces/chat 目录；默认数据根目录为 ~/.dsh。

@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings README · Introduction：

dsh-chat-settings

Per-conversation chat settings for DeepSeek Harness.

@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings README · Introduction：

Give one conversation its own system prompt, fold older turns out of context, override sampling, and switch it into a low-token pure chat mode — without touching global settings.

给单个对话加设置：对话级系统提示词、按轮数折叠上下文、采样参数，以及低 token 的纯聊天模式——不改全局配置。
@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings README · Introduction：

@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings README · What it does：| Conversation settings | Context control |
|---|---|
| A system prompt that belongs to one conversation only. | Keep the latest N turns; older ones fold into a single notice. |
| **Pure chat mode** | **Workspace opt-in** |
| Assemble the conversation with only its own instructions: no tools, no runtime context — a short greeting costs a fraction of the standard agent. | The settings button only appears in workspaces you check in Settings. |

@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings README · Install：**From npm** — published as [`@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings
```

Or install the package itself with `npm i @fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings`.

**从 npm 安装**：运行上面的 `dsh plugin add`，或直接 `npm i @fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings`。

@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings README · Install：**From a checkout** — point `dependencies` in the profile `package.json` at this directory with `link:` and add the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles`.

**从本地目录安装**：把 profile `package.json` 的依赖写成 `"@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings": "link:<this-dir>"`，并把包名加入 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings README · Use：1. **Settings → Chat settings** — check the workspaces that should expose the feature.  
   打开 **设置 → 对话设置**，勾选需要启用该功能的工作区。
2. A **Chat settings** button appears next to the conversation title and in the new-session row.  
   对话标题旁、新会话行会出现 **对话设置** 按钮。
3. Set the prompt, context turns and optional sampling values, then save.  
   填写提示词、上下文条数、可选采样参数并保存。
4. Tick **Pure chat mode** to assemble that conversation without tools or runtime context; untick to return to the standard prompt.  
   勾选 **纯聊天模式**，该对话的请求只保留自己的指令、不加载工具和环境上下文；取消勾选回到标准系统提示。

@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings README · Use：纯聊天在请求组装时完成，不切换 preset：系统提示只保留本对话的指令，每次请求都不携带工具声明，runtime 上下文、skill 目录、工作区指令和时间读数在请求里被过滤掉。这些都不写进会话日志，因此卸载插件不会留下指向插件私有身份的会话。

Leaving pure chat restores the full prompt and tool list on the next request. If a conversation refuses tool calls after the switch, open a new conversation: DSH's tool ledger treats a series that starts without tools as having no reusable baseline.

关闭纯聊天后的下一次请求会带回完整系统提示和工具列表。如果切换后该对话仍拒绝工具调用，开一个新对话即可——DSH 的工具账本会把“一开始就没有工具”的请求系列视为没有可复用基线。

</details>

@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings README · Uninstall：Nothing to migrate. Pure chat is a request-time override: the Session log never records a plugin-owned preset, so removing the plugin simply returns every conversation to the standard prompt and tools. Plugin data lives in `$DSH_HOME/chat-settings/settings.json` and can be deleted by hand.

不需要迁移。纯聊天是请求期覆盖：会话日志从不记录插件私有的 preset，卸载插件后所有对话直接回到标准系统提示和工具。插件数据位于 `$DSH_HOME/chat-settings/settings.json`，可以直接删除。

@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings README · Uninstall：Older versions (1.1.x and below) did switch pure-chat Sessions to a preset. On first start, 1.2.0 appends a final `standard` selection to any such Session log once; the preset identity is never registered again.

旧版本（1.1.x 及以下）会把纯聊天会话切到一个 preset。1.2.0 首次启动时会给这类会话日志追加一条最终的 `standard` 选择，之后不再注册那个 preset。

@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings README · Package layout：```
index.js            Host half: storage, HTTP routes, prompt/context/tools hooks
client.js           Client half: settings dialog and settings page
cordis.patch.yml    Loader patch: the plugin row
locale/             UI strings

@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings README · Scope：Not a general chat client, not a theme, not a replacement for DSH's own sessions. It only shapes how one conversation is assembled before the model is called.

不是通用聊天客户端，不是主题，也不替代 DSH 自己的会话管理——它只决定一个对话在调用模型前如何组装。

@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings README · Acknowledgements：The request-time pure-chat approach — suppressing prompt sections, tool declarations, runtime context and time readings instead of switching presets — was informed by [dsh-persona-select](https://github.com/gosutry/dsh-persona-select) by gosutry. Its use of `systemPrompt.suppressRuntimeContext()` and its `agent/pre-step` filtering pattern shaped this implementation.

@fallnstrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings README · Acknowledgements：纯聊天的请求期屏蔽方案（不切换 preset，而是在组装请求时压掉系统提示段、工具声明、runtime 上下文和时间读数）参考了 [dsh-persona-select](https://github.com/gosutry/dsh-persona-select)。它的 `systemPrompt.suppressRuntimeContext()` 用法和 `agent/pre-step` 过滤方式影响了这里的实现。
